title: TrackingRunMapping
description: Persisted mapping of one AblationKit attempt (or manual run) to its MLflow run, with sync state. Execution status lives with the job, not here.

ref.title: TrackingRunRef
ref.description: AblationKit's key for one tracked run: the attempt ID for job attempts, `mr-<id>` for runs created by hand.

kind.description: `attempt`: one execution attempt of a job. `manual`: created from the UI/CLI. `import`: a run that happened outside AblationKit, imported from its files (ADR 0043).

project_id.title: ProjectId
project_id.description: Stable project identifier (lowercase slug). Never a path; paths live in the local registry.

experiment_id.title: MlflowExperimentId
experiment_id.description: Set once MLflow acknowledges the experiment.

mlflow_run_id.title: MlflowRunId
mlflow_run_id.description: Set once MLflow acknowledges the run. Never invented.

attempt_id.title: AttemptId
attempt_id.description: Identifier of one attempt of a job.

study_id.title: StudyId
study_id.description: Study identifier (a planned comparison: baseline plus variants).

variant_id.title: VariantId
variant_id.description: Variant identifier (one configuration or code change under test).

task_id.title: TaskId
task_id.description: AblationKit task identifier (UI- or agent-first task).

sync_state.title: TrackingSyncState
sync_state.description: Whether MLflow has acknowledged every queued write: `tracking_pending` (queued or retrying), `synced`, or `sync_failed` (a write was rejected; retryable).

last_error.description: Last rejected or failed write, for display.

created_at.title: Timestamp
created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

updated_at.title: Timestamp
updated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

synced_at.title: Timestamp
synced_at.description: When the last queued write was acknowledged.

import_source.description: `import` runs: where the run's files were (a path in the checkout); one import per source.
